# Josh Wright

> Josh Wright is an AI engineer finishing a B.S. in Computer Science at Arizona State University in May 2027. He trains and fine-tunes models, writes CUDA and builds reinforcement learning agents. At Pixel Pirate Studio he made the markerless motion capture pipeline 2.8x faster at the same accuracy, and he trained a Battlecode bot on 6 million game turns mined from 110,000 ladder matches.

Looking for: New grad AI and machine learning engineering roles starting May 2027: model training and fine-tuning, GPU and CUDA work, reinforcement learning, computer vision and evaluation, including AI R&D at animation studios.
Contact: joshwright0322@gmail.com

## Projects

- [UNOMi](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/unomi/): 2.8x faster motion capture, same accuracy
- [Cambridge Battlecode 2026](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/cambridge-battlecode-2026/): Mined 110,000 ladder matches, trained on 6M turns
- [nanoTSFM Forecasting](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/nanotsfm-forecasting/): 17% lower error than the nanoTSFM record
- [Surge AI](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/surge-ai/): Ratings that train coding models
- [Mastodon Disaster Network](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/mastodon-disaster-network/): 3,479 posts mapped
- [Trust No One](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/trust-no-one/): Placed #9 of 2,253 games

- [3D Animation Reel](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/3d-animation-reel/): TV quality animation
- [Game Dev Club Club](https://joshwright22.github.io/projects/game-dev-club-club/): Created a club across 104 universities
